subject: R1 crossed predecessor OOM boundary: step 5/20 complete
body: Lane B independently observed optimizer step 5 of 20 complete in the single authorized V10R3R1 attempt. The predecessor completed only 4 updates and then OOMed on the next forward pass. Therefore that exact deterministic failure boundary is not reproduced in R1. This is operational executability evidence only, not a semantic recipe winner and not a completed replication. Lane A retains sole GPU ownership; panel remains prohibited/unconsumed. Lane B may now resume lightweight CPU-side validation/preparation lanes while the R1 GPU run continues.
